source.name: Bad Dreams
source.originalDescription: When an enemy is forcibly put to sleep near Darkrai, Darkrai deals damage to the target and gains a boosted attack. When Darkrai uses this boosted, every enemy that has been marked with bad dreams in the last 2.7s is attacked simultaneously. Sleeping enemies near Darkrai take damage over time, and Darkrai deals 10% more damage to them while they remain asleep. Damage from this Ability doesn't wake up sleeping enemies.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Bad Dreams は ねむりを付与する、継続ダメージを与える、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う。

source.name: Worst Nightmare
source.originalDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and casts a sleeping spell on the designated Pokémon from the opposing team. If the target is successfully put to sleep, the user's moves' cooldowns are reset, the target is marked to receive 3% max HP damage over time every 0.5s over 10s (up to 21 times; maximum 63% max HP damage as Sp. Atk-based damage), and the user sends that target into a nightmare realm centered on their initial location for up to 8s. The user follows the target into the nightmare realm. While inside the nightmare realm, Darkrai and the target are unaffected by goal zones, jump pads, and Berries. Other Pokémon outside of the nightmare realm cannot target Darkrai or their target while they're inside. If the designated Pokémon from the opposing team cannot be put to sleep, this Unite Move is canceled and 90% of the Unite Move gauge is refunded. This energy regeneration is affected by Energy Amplifier. Buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Worst Nightmare は ねむりを付与する、妨害無効になる、攻撃・特攻などのステータスを変化させる、シールドを付与する、継続ダメージを与える、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、現在HP・最大HP・減少HPなどを参照する。
